about_the_game:
You are trapped in a nightmare and have to escape!

  • Switch Between Three Zones
    Each time you change zones, you enter a new procedural generated labyrinth with unique layouts, challenges, and mysteries to uncover.

  • Explore Endless Corridors
    Roam through eerie, ever-shifting hallways in search of hidden rooms, useful items, puzzles, tasks, and clues to help with your escape. But be careful—each turn could take you deeper into the unknown and away from the safe zone.

  • Find Your Way Back
    Keep an eye out for subtle hints and environmental clues that can guide you back to safety. You can also use various items to help you find your way back, such as pebbles or chalk.

  • Limited Safe Exploration Time
    You can only roam the corridors safely for a short period. The longer you stay, the more dangerous your nightmare becomes.

  • Run or Hide
    Facing a nightmare creature head-on is a losing battle. Your best chance at survival is to find a hiding spot or escape before it’s too late.

  • Find Three Dreamstones
    The only way out of your nightmare is to find all three dreamstones. Complete tasks that help you unlock new areas, solve puzzles and search for clues to locate them.

  • Help Others
    Assist the mysterious figures trapped in your dream to earn valuable hints, useful items, and new opportunities.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz Quad-core Intel or AMD processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 470 GTX or AMD Radeon 6870 HD
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Explore endless labyrinths of eerie hallways while being hunted by an evil spider teddy. Locate different rooms, complete tasks, survive the surreal corridors and find the exit from your nightmare!
supported_languages:
English*, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Russian
*languages with full audio support
